tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: She not only sings but also writes her own songs.
items.transformed: Not _________ but she also writes her own songs.

items.original: We had hardly started when the rain came.
I only understood the problem when he explained it.
items.transformed: Only when he explained it _________ the problem.

items.original: The teacher had never seen such a good essay.
You will not find a better restaurant anywhere.
He said nothing about his plans at any time.
items.transformed: At no time _________ about his plans.

items.original: If I had known about it, I would have helped.
items.transformed: _________ about it, I would have helped.
